data.job_title: Graduate Engineer Trainee -Flight Electronics Research Engineer
data.skills: Flight Electronics, Avionics Systems, Embedded Systems, Real-Time Systems, Flight Controllers, PX4, ArduPilot, Sensor Integration, IMU, GPS, Barometer, Sensor Fusion, Communication Protocols, CAN, SPI, UART, I2C, Ethernet, Embedded C, Microcontrollers, STM32, NXP, TI Processors, RTOS, FPGA, Digital Electronics, Verilog, VHDL, Digital Logic Design, UAVCAN, Embedded Debugging, Low-Latency Systems, Sensor Synchronization, Data Acquisition, Control Systems, Embedded Hardware
data.eligibility_information:
Candidates will be considered only if they do not have any active backlogs in any academic year/semester. Candidates with previous backlogs will be considered only if all backlogs have been successfully cleared and passed.

Only candidates with no active backlogs and completed academic qualifications will be eligible for consideration.
data.additional_information:
Work on research and development of avionics architectures, flight controller systems, sensor interfaces, real-time embedded systems, and next-generation FPGA-assisted flight electronics platforms. 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 
Research flight controller architectures for unmanned aerial systems. 
Study real-time embedded systems and deterministic control requirements.
Analyze IMU, barometer, GPS, and sensor interface integration techniques. 
Investigate sensor synchronization and low-latency data acquisition methods. 
Study communication buses including CAN, SPI, UART, I2C, and Ethernet. 
Research redundancy and fail-safe mechanisms in avionics systems. 
Evaluate FPGA-assisted architectures for sensor processing and control acceleration. 
Study PX4, ArduPilot, and custom flight control software architectures. 
Support bring-up and validation of avionics and embedded control hardware. 
Prepare subsystem architecture reports and technical evaluation documents. 

Skills Required 
Strong understanding of embedded systems and digital electronics. 
Familiarity with microcontrollers and real-time processing concepts. 
Understanding of communication protocols and sensor interfacing methods. 
Ability to analyze timing, synchronization, and control system behavior. 
Understanding of flight electronics fundamentals and embedded debugging. 

PREFERRED SKILLS 
Exposure to STM32, NXP, TI, or equivalent embedded platforms. 
Familiarity with RTOS concepts and interrupt-driven systems. 
Exposure to FPGA fundamentals and digital logic design concepts. 
Familiarity with Verilog, VHDL, or FPGA development workflows. 
Exposure to PX4, ArduPilot, UAVCAN, or related avionics frameworks. 

QUALIFICATIONS -M.Tech/M.E/PhD
EXPERIENCE REQUIRED-0-2 Years
data.additional_details:
Please find below the additional important details regarding our Company Clauses & Policies:

1.NDA – Non-Disclosure Agreement
Candidates must not disclose or share any confidential information related to their job role, projects, company operations, or work responsibilities with any external party. This clause will remain applicable for a lifetime.
2.NCC – Non-Compete Clause
Upon joining the company, when you decide to leave the organization in the future, you will not be eligible to join any direct competitor of the company for a period of 3 years post the last working day.
3.Minimum Service Agreement – 2 Years
Candidates from any branch having less than 2 Years of Experience are required to sign a mandatory 2-year Minimum Service Agreement. However, Candidates with more than 2 years of prior experience are exempted from the Minimum Service Agreement. Additionally breach of this agreement will result in a financial penalty of 40% of the CTC.
